sku_reviews.author: maldita

sku_reviews.author: MeMa

sku_reviews.author: ivmh
sku_reviews.title: Perfect jacket for traveling
sku_reviews.body: I have a 3 week trip to Asia coming up and have been looking for pieces with the most versatility to cut down on my luggage weight. This jacket checks so many of my boxes. It's lightweight and packs down small. It can easily be thrown in a day bag or tied around your waist if you're not sure how the weather will be that day. It has some amount of waterproofing so getting caught in a little rain won't be a big deal, and a hood that's actually big enough to cover my whole head. It has nice big pockets with snap buttons to keep your things secure, as well as slit pockets so you can still keep your hands out of the wind and rain without having to unbutton the big pockets. It has both a zipper and button closures. And the style itself will go with everything, it's not too obviously sporty unlike the other shell jackets that I already have. The elastic cinches at the waist so you can wear it boxy and longer, or baggy and cropped. I usually wear small and sized up to M for an oversized fit.

sku_reviews.author: Team PreshrunkCotton
sku_reviews.title: Shrinks
sku_reviews.body: Please, Uniqlo, please pre-shrink your cotton! There are many Uniqlo items I’ve bought over the years that shrink terribly (washing/drying per instructions). sku_reviews.title: Almost perfect

While the sleeves, shoulders, chest are all fine, though with an appropriately relaxed feel, the length of the shirt is just a touch too long. This may sort itself out after a wash, but, if not tucked in, it hangs just a bit too low. Tuck it in and it’s perfectly fine. I really want to give this five stars since it’s an otherwise perfect mock neck, but the length seems like an oversight. Size down and you might loose some of the relaxed flow of the true to size, go for you own size and you’ll either need to tuck in or be fine with the somewhat oversized length. Despite that, it’s an excellent shirt and recommended.

The fit is clean and versatile enough that you can wear it for exercise or casually. After several wears and washes, it has held up well and still maintains its shape. Overall, the Dry-EX T-Shirt is lightweight, comfortable, quick-drying, and great for everyday active wear. Definitely a solid choice if you prioritize comfort and breathability.
